source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "open data" AND (city OR cities OR municipal) AND (government OR governance OR transparency)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"open data" AND (city OR cities OR municipal) AND (government OR governance OR transparency),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("open data" AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "municipal") AND ("governance" OR "government" OR "transparency"))
